title: Authorize access
wantsAccess: wants to access your CloudCLI account.
callbackWarning: Your authorization code will be sent to

scopes.read: Read projects, sessions, runs and status
scopes.sessionSend: Send messages to existing sessions (the session runs commands)
scopes.sessionCreate: Start new sessions (the session runs commands)
scopes.sessionControl: Interrupt runs, start and close sessions, stop background tasks
scopes.navigate: Open a session in one of your browsers
scopes.other: Additional permission requested by this application

writeWarning: This application will be able to send, create and control sessions. Only allow it if you trust it.
revokeHint: You can revoke this access at any time in Settings → Connected Apps.
passwordHint: Re-enter your password to confirm this authorization.

errors.missingRequest: This link is missing required parameters. Start the connection again from the application.
errors.invalidRequest: This authorization request is not valid. It may have expired or come from an unregistered application.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many password attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
